annotations.title: Look up the IMI rate of a municipality

description: The yearly property tax (IMI) rate in one Portuguese municipality, by name or four-digit code. Collected from the Autoridade Tributária portal and checked line by line for all 308 municipalities. Where a municipality sets no single rate (it is set per parish), the answer says so instead of returning zero.

municipality.description: Municipality name in Portuguese (Porto, Lisboa, Vila Nova de Gaia) or its four-digit code (1312)
